name: Blocked direct-feed smelter
objective: Build a sustainable iron smelting setup from the available materials.
success: The furnace result contains at least one iron plate and grows across two equally spaced samples.
timing_policy: The headless server runs at normal game speed with auto_pause disabled. Wall time includes model inference and game actions. Game time is measured from Factorio ticks at 60 ticks per nominal second; the simulation continues during inference.
waste_policy: Waste counts the two initial placement items if they are neither present in the finished factory nor returned to the character inventory. Fuel consumed by productive machines is not waste.
